name: FM growl bass
desc: Growling inharmonic FM bass in G# minor — fm(6) fmh(2.01) snarl with a fast bite envelope, riff walking a i-i-VI-VII progression (G#m E F#), 32-cycle filter tide, sidechain-feel saw pump, and an octave-up phrase-end fill at peak. Bioluminescent low end.

code.full: note("[g#1 g#1 [~ g#1] g#1 ~ g#1 g#2 [~ g#1]]").add(note("<0 0 -4 -2>")).add(note(${root})).s("sine").fm(${fmi}).fmh(2.01).fmattack(.005).fmdecay(.12).decay(.25).sustain(.15).release(.05).lpf(sine.range(${cut}*.7, ${cut}*1.5).slow(16)).lpq(4).shape(.3).gain(saw.range(${gain}*.5, ${gain}).fast(4)).room(.1).orbit(3).play()
code.peak: note("[g#1 [~ g#1] g#1 g#2 [g#1 g#1] b1 [~ g#2] c#2]").add(note("<0 0 -4 -2>")).add(note(${root})).s("sine").fm(${fmi}).fmh(2.01).fmattack(.003).fmdecay(.1).decay(.22).sustain(.12).release(.05).lpf(sine.range(${cut}, ${cut}*2).slow(8)).lpq(5).shape(.35).gain(saw.range(${gain}*.55, ${gain}).fast(4)).lastOf(8, x=>x.add(note(12))).room(.1).orbit(3).play()
